subject: planner: forbid generate `PointGet` plan with partition table + `_tidb_rowid` (#54592)
summary: Reviewed planner changes to PointGet generation/pruning for partitioned (non-clustered) tables with `_tidb_rowid`. The new guards correctly prevent incorrect PointGet/fast-plan usage unless exactly one partition is explicitly selected, and the added partition-name->PartitionIdx mapping in `PointGetPlan.PrunePartitions` makes the allowed single-partition case execute against the intended partition. Integration test coverage matches the intended semantics (scan all partitions vs PointGet on single explicit partition). Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and found no follow-up fixes indicating a remaining Blocker/High issue in this change.
